verdict.reason: The reviewed launcher bytes did not enforce the contract's canonical repository path even though the contract declared contract_clone_allowed=false.

finding.title: Exact-byte contract clone passed the old launcher's root-of-trust gate
finding.evidence: A byte-identical temporary copy retained SHA256 6eedc33a... and advanced to the later local relocation rejection, exactly like the canonical contract. The old launcher checked content SHA but not contract_path == canonical repository path.
finding.impact: No semantic or byte substitution was possible, so this was not a false-evidence P0. It nevertheless contradicted the explicit contract_clone_allowed=false policy and weakened unique-command provenance.
finding.required_fix: Require the resolved --contract path to equal the resolved canonical in-repository contract before checking the pinned SHA.
